results.rationale: CO-PROFILE explicitly confirms we hold ISO 27001, satisfying the mandatory certification requirement.
We show multiple recent cybersecurity engagements, but the provided records do not demonstrate three engagements within five years specifically for government or financial-sector clients as required.
CO-PROFILE shows average annual turnover of PKR 900M over the last three audited years, which is below the required PKR 1,200M threshold.
No evidence in CO-PROFILE indicates CISSP/GIAC (or equivalent) certified security professionals to cover all three SOC monitoring tiers as mandated.
Procedural commitment — complied with in the submission (and CO-PROFILE indicates we can arrange bank guarantees/CDR up to the stated facility limit).

Forward technical proposal obligation is credible based on our network design and cybersecurity delivery experience, enabling us to propose SIEM/SOAR capacity, retention, and HA architecture in the bid.
We can credibly propose a tiered 24x7 SOC staffing model and SLAs based on cybersecurity experience, but CO-PROFILE only evidences a 24–48h support SLA rather than explicit 24x7 coverage.
Threat-intelligence sources and proactive hunting methodology can be credibly described based on our prior cybersecurity/SOC-type engagement experience.
